description.value: Genoa Bay Café is a waterfront restaurant perched on the site of the historic Genoa Bay Sawmill, offering scenic marina views near Duncan on Vancouver Island. The menu leans heavily on local seafood — mussels, halibut chowder, tuna poke, and Dungeness — alongside craft cocktails and a curated wine list. Reservations are strongly recommended, making this a worthwhile destination stop for cyclists exploring the Cowichan Valley.
